wizard.title: Instagram Session Wizard
wizard.subtitle: An Instagram session is required to fetch high quality media and active stories.
wizard.method_auto_desc: Extracts Instagram session cookies from your desktop browser securely and encrypted.
wizard.method_manual_desc: Upload a 'cookies.txt' file exported from your browser extension.
wizard.browser_select: Browser where you are logged into Instagram:
wizard.browser_close_tip: Important: To avoid SQLite database locks, close your browser completely before clicking 'Extract Cookies'.
wizard.manual_guide_title: How to Get Your Cookie File?
wizard.manual_guide_step1: 1. Install the 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' extension in your browser.
wizard.manual_guide_step2: 2. Navigate to instagram.com and log in to your account.
wizard.manual_guide_step3: 3. Click the extension icon and click 'Export' to save the txt file.
wizard.manual_guide_step4: 4. Click below to select the exported cookie file.
wizard.error_locked: Browser database is locked because the browser is still running. Please close it completely and retry.
wizard.error_not_found: No Instagram session found. Please make sure you are logged into Instagram in that browser.
wizard.error_invalid_txt: The selected file does not contain valid Instagram cookies (sessionid).
